title: Field Service Pro
description: A multi-tenant field service platform for small trade businesses: CRM, work orders, drag-and-drop scheduling, a mobile technician view, estimates, invoicing, a customer portal and a building and asset registry. React and Express on Postgres with Keycloak SSO, plus a read-only MCP server so AI agents can work with it. A demo runs on Azure; 14 launch blockers are still open, including invoices and estimates created in the UI losing their line items.

video.caption: Signed in as a demo technician through the MCP server, Claude answers her questions from live job data and sees only her own jobs. Every call is audit-logged.
